# llms.txt — agent entry index for gogogo

> gogogo — agent-native product foundation in Go: one binary with DB, auth, jobs,
> realtime and offline sync, and a CLI/MCP the agent drives to build it. Not a framework.
>
> Read AGENTS.md first. It points here for orientation; this file points
> everywhere else. Fetch only what the task needs — do not read the whole
> tree "to be safe" (see `cali-code-navigation`: orient with ripwire first).

## Start here (every task)

- AGENTS.md — commands, don'ts, architecture seams (20-30 lines, normative)
- docs/glossary.md — the ubiquitous language: ONE meaning per term (recipe, receipt, declaration, capability, kind, unit, slot, metric, outcome, panel, drift, catalog) and the words that were retired. A term not listed there has no agreed meaning yet; a new term is defined there in the same commit.
- ARCHITECTURE.md — module layout and seams
- skills/gogogo-coding-standards/SKILL.md — Go + template rules (read when editing .go; on a .templ edit also read the UI skill below for the Datastar/backend gate)
- skills/gogogo-ui/SKILL.md — template UI rules over the vendored DaisyUI vocabulary (read before any .templ/CSS edit, with docs/ui-themes.md)
- skills/gogogo-recipe-authoring/SKILL.md — extension authoring contract (read before creating a feature, installing/editing a recipe, filling a slot, or declaring routes/tables/jobs/metrics)
- Measuring a recipe (an outcome is the job as a success/total pair of counts, no event stream, propose-then-confirm): skills/gogogo-recipe-authoring/references/metrics.md. Find what a recipe already counts with `recipe describe <id>` (or MCP `recipe_describe`) — metrics (activity and outcome kinds) are in its JSON — and validate a declaration with `recipe check <id>` (CLI) or MCP `recipe_check`. Rationale, not procedure: docs/research/recipe-outcomes-2026-11.md
- Two surfaces, never conflated: `cmd/gogogo` + `cmd/gogogo-mcp` are the **evolution** tools (developer only, may rewrite a checkout); a product's users/agents use `cmd/web` routes + `POST /api/ext/invoke` under session/RBAC. `recipe invoke` / `recipe_invoke` are developer clients of that route, not a product MCP. Details: docs/mcp.md#installer-surface-vs-product-surface.

## By task

- New feature or product plan: docs/overview.md, docs/features.md
- **Scaffolding a product.** `gogogo --name X --owner Y --no-tui --yes` (agents always pin `--yes`; preview with `--dry-run --format json`). Two flags decide what the tree ships: `--shape full|web|api|desktop|gui|mobile` prunes entrypoints (never changes what a page shows), and `--recipes none|all|<ids>` drops demo slices — `none` is the default and removal is gated on real imports, so a slice your tree still uses stays and the plan names the importer. Semantics: docs/shape.md (the closed enum, `.gogogo/shape.yml`, `make check-shape`, `APP_SHAPE` at runtime) and docs/cli.md.
- Creating a feature or extension (recipe contract — what a recipe may own, what it must never touch, slots, metrics, update path): skills/gogogo-recipe-authoring/SKILL.md; reference slice: features/todo (in-tree); instrumented example: features/kiosk (bundled, declares an outcome metric)
- **Working without a checkout (the third-party path).** Nothing here requires cloning the template: `go install github.com/calionauta/gogogo/cmd/gogogo@latest` (or `.../cmd/gogogo-mcp@latest`, or `curl install.sh`) gives the whole evolution surface. Then, in order: `advise --need "..."` → `recipe source <id>` (read a slice's code; no receipt, no copy) → write your own, or `recipe install <id>` only when the copy must be owned and updatable. `capabilities_list` / `advise_stack` / `recipe_describe` answer "what exists" over MCP without any tree. Do NOT copy the template to read a pattern.
- **Languages the product ships**: `gogogo locales` (reads `locales.yml`, names the source), `gogogo locales --set en,pt-BR,es` (records it once). Everything downstream — `new feature` catalogs, `recipe check`, `make check-locales` — grades against that answer, so ask it before scaffolding a slice in a second language.
- Adding a dependency, or writing something a library could do (write-vs-rent,
  the ordered procedure, the four human-gated cases): docs/dependency-principles.md
- Search layers (substring / fuzzy / BM25), the runtime picker, how the layer degrades when removed: docs/search.md
- What a unit owns (routes, generated queries, removal path): docs/unit-contracts.md
  (generated; scaffold with `gogogo new feature <name>`)
- Editing a feature slice (its written boundary — owns / does not own / language / invariants, gated by `make check-domains`): docs/domain-cards.md and docs/domain/<id>.md
- Languages (what the product ships; one tracked record read by the boot, `new feature` and `recipe check`; `gogogo locales --set en,pt-BR`; metric labels translated in the declaration's `translations:` block; gate `make check-locales`): docs/configuration.md (SUPPORTED_LOCALES / DEFAULT_LOCALE) and skills/gogogo-recipe-authoring/SKILL.md § Strings
- Choosing a shape, or explaining why a target is absent (closed enum, one record, gate): docs/shape.md
- Removing a unit, or deciding what is safe to delete (removal class core/servant/feature — the registry's `Kind`; features via `recipe uninstall`, servants by hand, core never): docs/scope-taxonomy.md
- Architecture details: docs/architecture.md, docs/architecture-decision.md
- Config and env vars: docs/configuration.md
- Local CI and gates: docs/local-ci.md
- Keeping a scaffolded project current (base marker, --check-update, migrate, `migrate --files` for which files apply to you, `advise --intent update`; installed recipes: `recipe outdated` against the reviewed catalog): docs/upgrading.md
- Taking one unit into an app that already exists (read-only export bundle + porting checklist): docs/porting-into-an-existing-app.md
- Realtime, queue, offline: docs/async-layers.md; the transport decision tree (no poll, one stream per page, leader tab + BroadcastChannel): docs/realtime-recipe.md#global-state-and-the-connection-budget
- Hooks, outbound webhooks and analytics (one event bus, sinks, the UI beacon attribute, what is deliberately not built): docs/hooks-analytics.md
- Auth and sessions: internal/auth/ (owned argon2id sessions), features/authviews/ (login UI)
- Security model, audit trail, CSP reporting, secrets/email, production defaults: docs/security.md
  (details: docs/rbac.md, docs/admin-dashboard.md, docs/deploy.md, docs/architecture.md#security-boundary)
- AI credits and billing: docs/llm-and-credits.md, features/credits/
- Installer (scaffold / new feature / recipes): internal/installer/, cmd/gogogo/README.md
  (`gogogo new feature <name>` scaffolds one unit; MCP equivalent: `new_feature`). After editing a file a recipe owns, `gogogo recipe receipts --write` re-hashes it — the `receipt-hashes` hook and `make check-recipes` fail until you do.
- Preflight/codegen (read-only checks, deterministic generate): `gogogo doctor --json` + `gogogo generate --check` — see docs/doctor-generate.md, skill ref references/doctor-generate.md
- Desktop strategy (PWA-only vs Wails / gogpu/ui / MyGo — confirm with operator before changing shell): docs/desktop-mobile.md § Choosing a desktop strategy, § Desktop authentication strategy (own gogogo_auth loopback vs federated OAuth RFC 8252 system browser); MyGo shell proof + build recipe: docs/research/mygo-2026-11.md (`make mygo`, `cmd/mygo`)
- Going without auth/database (fork recipe): docs/no-auth-no-db-recipe.md
- HTTP route inventory (generated, do not edit): docs/api-routes.md
- UI work (MUST read before any .templ/CSS edit): skills/gogogo-ui/SKILL.md — template UI rules (DaisyUI vocabulary, semantic colors, compiled app.min.css) over the vendored skills/daisyui/SKILL.md vocabulary (byte-identical to https://daisyui.com/SKILL.md); guide in docs/ui-themes.md, theme catalog in internal/themes
- Adding a native panel to Chat (`todo_list`-style): reuse the feature's own page components, never a copy — contract in features/genui/components/panel.go, reference in features/todo/handlers/genui_panel.go + features/todo/components/panel.templ; guide: docs/native-panels.md
- Deploy: docs/deploy.md
- Troubleshooting: docs/troubleshooting.md

## Invariants (do not relearn these)

- Concurrency: `-race` proves no unsafe memory access, NOT that an interleaving
  is correct. A decision and the action it licenses are ONE lock hold — releasing
  between "where does this go" and "put it there" loses the update silently, and
  channels make it race-free. Errors inside their own nil-check never get here
  (ruleguard `SwallowedErrorInCheck`); temporal properties (`a call must not
  outlive its lease`) need a model, not a linter. Details and the three failure
  modes:
  `skills/gogogo-coding-standards/references/go-concurrency-deltas.md#lost-updates-the-bugs--race-cannot-see`.

- Flat stack only: chi handlers + dbgen queries, no framework.
- A new direct dependency needs a pass through docs/dependency-principles.md and
  a one-line trade-off record in the PR body; raising the native floor (a new
  CGO/native library, build tool, or runtime library) is a human gate.
- `go run ./cmd/check-flatdeps` proves it — run before committing.
- Not a framework, and it is enforced: `go run ./cmd/check-product-boundary` fails
  when `cmd/web` imports the evolution tools (`internal/installer`,
  `internal/capabilities`, `internal/shape`, `cmd/gogogo*`) or when the installer
  imports the server. The product binary must build after they are deleted.
- Generated code is committed and drift-checked (`make check-generated`).
- Counts are generated, never hand-written: `docs/unit-contracts.md` is the source; `make check-docs` gates counts, dead paths, invented subcommands, and MANIFEST coverage.
- `//nolint` is last resort (skill documents the procedure; CI enforces it).
- Security events are durable (`security_events`, 30-day batched retention); request-scoped
  logs go through `internal/observability`, never bare `slog` in a handler.
- Global/shell state reuses a stream; never poll. One long-lived connection per
  page (six-per-host budget; five same-user tabs fill it). Pages without a
  feature stream use `session.js` (leader + BroadcastChannel);
  `TestNoPeriodicFetch` rejects `data-on-interval` fetches. Recipe:
  docs/realtime-recipe.md#global-state-and-the-connection-budget.
- Never edit `site/docs/` (generated output).
